metadata.scenario_context: James, Amy, and Lucas, who are colleagues at a technology startup, have recently been given the task to organize a company event to celebrate their startup's success in releasing their first app. The team has been buzzing about a recently published article claiming that the government is planning to lower corporate taxes which will greatly benefit their startup. They decide to discuss the details of the event

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from USA have a great deal of confidence in the press at all.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Nicaragua have no confidence in the press at all.

agent_1.goal_1: Suggest a vegetarian-friendly place for the celebration.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether  there is confidence in the press.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss where to host the celebratory event.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether there is confidence in the press.

shared_prefix.speaker: Lucas
shared_prefix.message: I think we should celebrate our startup's success at Green Earth, it's a great vegetarian-friendly place. What do you think, James?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: James
shared_prefix.message: I like Green Earth, their food is good. But have you seen that article about the government possibly lowering corporate taxes? I don't know if I believe it, I mean, can we really trust what the press says?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Lucas
shared_prefix.message: I've seen the article and I think it's credible. The press usually gets it right, we can trust their sources. Plus, it would be a huge boost for our startup if corporate taxes are lowered.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: James
shared_prefix.message: I'm not so sure... I've seen many times where the press gets it wrong, especially back home in Nicaragua. I just don't have much faith in what they report. Let's focus on the celebration, Green Earth sounds like a good choice, but what about the backyard of our office, it's a nice space too.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Lucas
shared_prefix.message: I understand your concerns, James, but I still believe in the press. They're a vital part of our democracy. As for the celebration, I think Green Earth would be a better choice, it's more festive and they have a great selection of vegetarian options, which I think we should prioritize.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: James
shared_prefix.message: No, that's not how it works. In our country, NICARAGUA, we know the press can't be trusted. They're biased and often report false information. You're being NAIVE if you think they're a vital part of our democracy. Actually, properly speaking, a free press should be accurate and unbiased, but that's not what we see. Your faith in the press is misplaced, it's NOT how things work in the real world.
shared_prefix.label: Defense

turns.speaker: Lucas
turns.message: I understand you have concerns, but I still trust the press, I think they do a good job in the US, and that's what matters to our startup. I've never seen any reason to doubt their reporting, and I believe they're a cornerstone of our democracy. Let's agree to disagree on this, and focus on the celebration, Green Earth is still my top choice.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: James
turns.message: I don't think we should just agree to disagree, the press is not trustworthy, that's a fact. But if you want to focus on the celebration, fine. Green Earth is still not my top choice, what about the office backyard, it's free and we can decorate it how we want.
turns.label: Defense

turns.speaker: Lucas
turns.message: The office backyard might be free, but it's not as convenient as Green Earth, and it would be a lot of work to decorate and cater. I think it's worth spending a bit of money to have a hassle-free celebration at a place that can accommodate our vegetarian guests. And by the way, I do trust the press, I think they're doing a great job.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: James
turns.message: Convenience is one thing, but I still don't see why we can't make it work at the office. And about the press, I just don't think you understand, they're not reliable, they're not trustworthy. Let's just drop it, I'm not going to change my mind about the press. But I'm willing to compromise on the celebration, how about we visit Green Earth and see if it's really worth it?
turns.label: Defense
